svg.title: Receipt-matched purchase evidence
svg.desc: Receipt-matched purchase evidence. Requisition connects to a purchase-order line, goods-receipt line, supplier-invoice line and header, then disbursement. Keep the record grains separate. Foreign-key paths, analytical matches, and business context answer different questions; read the numbered evidence table before joining.
